inputExample.text: You are an idiot and I hate you.

usage.outputShape: body.verdict ("allow"|"review"|"block"), body.flagged_count, body.summary, body.categories.{harassment,hate_speech,violence,sexual_content,self_harm,spam,phishing,doxing,illegal_activity}.{score,flagged,evidence}, body.model, body.source, body.input_chars
usage.guide: POST the text you want moderated as JSON {"text": "..."} to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/moderate-content; payment is x402 USDC on Base (~$0.02 per call), no API key. The response is plain sync JSON: read body.verdict for the top-level decision (allow / review / block), body.flagged_count for how many categories tripped, and body.categories.<category>.{score,flagged,evidence} for per-category detail. body.summary gives a human-readable rationale.
